responsibility: Defines Linux-specific target configuration for the S/390 backend, including ABI-visible C type sizes, preprocessor builtins, assembler and linker specs, multilib defaults, dynamic linker paths, stack protector TLS offsets, and a few libc/binutils compatibility hooks. It is the OS layer that adapts the generic s390 target to Linux userland conventions, especially 31-bit versus 64-bit ABI behavior and -march arch-name rewriting for older assemblers.
